cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

project(orc-videosynth-tests)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The videosynth suite: decode-orc's stages run against sources generated by
# the videosynth revision pinned in flake.nix. Local only; TESTING.md
# ("videosynth suite") says how to run it and how to add a case.

# The pinned binary and source tree come from the default nix dev shell. They
# are taken from the environment on every configure, so re-entering the shell
# after a pin move and reconfiguring picks up the new pin.
foreach(_videosynth_var VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE VIDEOSYNTH_SOURCE_DIR)
    if(DEFINED ENV{${_videosynth_var}})
        set(${_videosynth_var} "$ENV{${_videosynth_var}}" CACHE STRING
            "Set from the nix dev shell" FORCE)
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE)
    find_program(VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE videosynth)
endif()
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)

set(_videosynth_script
    "${VIDEOSYNTH_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/generate_test_projects.py")
if(NOT VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE OR NOT EXISTS "${VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE}"
   OR NOT EXISTS "${_videosynth_script}" OR NOT Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "BUILD_VIDEOSYNTH_TESTS needs the pinned videosynth and python3.\n"
        "Configure from the default dev shell (`nix develop`), which provides "
        "videosynth and sets VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE and VIDEOSYNTH_SOURCE_DIR.\n"
        "  VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE: '${VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE}'\n"
        "  VIDEOSYNTH_SOURCE_DIR: '${VIDEOSYNTH_SOURCE_DIR}'\n"
        "  python3 found: ${Python3_Interpreter_FOUND}")
endif()

set(ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/videosynth-projects")
set(ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/videosynth-output")
set(_orc_projects "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/projects")
set(_upstream_projects "${VIDEOSYNTH_SOURCE_DIR}/projects")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived projects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The pinned source's generate_test_projects.py derives the Y/C renderings,
# truth copies and capture sets: from decode-orc's own projects into
# videosynth-projects/orc/, and from the upstream projects into
# videosynth-projects/upstream/. Each output tree is cleared first, so a rule
# that is removed leaves nothing behind.
file(GLOB_RECURSE _orc_project_files CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${_orc_projects}/*.yaml" "${_orc_projects}/variants.json")
set(_projects_stamp "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/.derived-stamp")
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${_projects_stamp}"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -rf
            "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/orc"
            "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/upstream"
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${_videosynth_script}" --quiet
            --source "${_orc_projects}"
            --output "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/orc"
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${_videosynth_script}" --quiet
            --source "${_upstream_projects}"
            --output "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/upstream"
    # The FM-beat case's truth: its noise-free copy without the beat.
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory
            "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/orc/fm-beat-truth"
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/drop_channel_block.py"
            "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/orc/fm-beat-clean/pal_fm_beat_clean.yaml"
            "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/orc/fm-beat-truth/pal_fm_beat_truth.yaml"
            videosynth_pal_fm_beat_clean videosynth_pal_fm_beat_truth
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch "${_projects_stamp}"
    DEPENDS ${_orc_project_files}
            "${_upstream_projects}/variants.json"
            "${_videosynth_script}"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/drop_channel_block.py"
    COMMENT "Deriving videosynth projects into ${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}"
    VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(videosynth-projects ALL DEPENDS "${_projects_stamp}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cases
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# orc_videosynth_case(<case> <project.yaml>)
#
# Registers videosynth_generate_<case>, the CTest fixture that generates the
# project into videosynth-output/<case>/. Tests that read the case name it in
# orc_videosynth_tests(... CASES <case>). Generation is skipped while the
# case's stamp matches (generate_case.cmake).
function(orc_videosynth_case case project)
    add_test(NAME videosynth_generate_${case}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            "-DVIDEOSYNTH=${VIDEOSYNTH_EXECUTABLE}"
            "-DPROJECT=${project}"
            "-DOUTPUT_DIR=${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR}/${case}"
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/generate_case.cmake")
    set_tests_properties(videosynth_generate_${case} PROPERTIES
        FIXTURES_SETUP videosynth_${case}
        LABELS "functional;videosynth")
endfunction()

# orc_videosynth_tests(<target> TEST <Suite.Test> CASES <case>...)
#
# Registers one test of <target>, requiring the generation fixtures of CASES,
# so running one test generates only its cases. Every test also requires the
# run report (below). The tests find their cases through
# ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR and their baselines through
# ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_BASELINES.
function(orc_videosynth_tests target)
    cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "" "TEST" "CASES" ${ARGN})
    set(_fixtures videosynth_report)
    foreach(_case IN LISTS ARG_CASES)
        list(APPEND _fixtures videosynth_${_case})
    endforeach()
    string(REPLACE ";" "\;" _fixtures "${_fixtures}")
    string(REPLACE ";" "," _cases "${ARG_CASES}")
    gtest_discover_tests(${target}
        TEST_FILTER "${ARG_TEST}"
        DISCOVERY_MODE POST_BUILD
        DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT 30
        PROPERTIES
            LABELS "functional\;videosynth"
            FIXTURES_REQUIRED "${_fixtures}"
            ENVIRONMENT "ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR=${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR}\;ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_BASELINES=${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_BASELINES}\;ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_CASES=${_cases}")
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_TEST_MANIFEST
        "${ARG_TEST} ${_cases}")
endfunction()

find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
include(GoogleTest)

# The shared main and harness: case directories, baselines, and each test's
# result for the run report.
add_library(orc-videosynth-harness STATIC
    harness/videosynth_harness.cpp
    harness/videosynth_main.cpp
)
target_include_directories(orc-videosynth-harness PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/harness)
target_link_libraries(orc-videosynth-harness PUBLIC
    orc-core
    orc-videosynth-support
    GTest::gtest
)

# orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(<target> SOURCES <src>... STAGES <stage>...)
#
# Built like orc-tests/core/functional: linked to orc-core and to the stage
# plugins it runs in process (each STAGE names a directory under
# orc/plugins/stages, its plugin target orc-stage-plugin-<stage with - for _>).
# Every executable opens its cases through cvbs_source
# (harness/videosynth_cases.h), so that stage is always linked.
function(orc_add_videosynth_test_executable target)
    cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "" "" "SOURCES;STAGES" ${ARGN})
    add_executable(${target} ${ARG_SOURCES}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/harness/videosynth_cases.cpp)
    list(PREPEND ARG_STAGES cvbs_source)
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES ARG_STAGES)
    target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/sdk/include
    )
    target_link_libraries(${target}
        orc-core
        orc-videosynth-harness
        SQLite::SQLite3
    )
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE
        ORC_STAGE_PLUGIN_BUILD_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/orc-stage-plugins"
    )
    foreach(_stage IN LISTS ARG_STAGES)
        target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
            ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/plugins/stages/${_stage})
        string(REPLACE "_" "-" _plugin "orc-stage-plugin-${_stage}")
        if(TARGET ${_plugin})
            target_link_libraries(${target} ${_plugin})
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(TARGET orc-stage-plugins)
        add_dependencies(${target} orc-stage-plugins)
    endif()
    add_dependencies(${target} videosynth-projects)
endfunction()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baselines and the run report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# baselines.json holds each test's recorded metrics. videosynth_report_reset
# clears the previous run's results before any test runs; videosynth_report
# runs after the last of them and writes videosynth-output/report.md and
# report.json, and, with ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_UPDATE_BASELINES=1, rewrites
# baselines.json from the run.
set(ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_BASELINES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/baselines.json")
set(_manifest "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/videosynth-tests.txt")

# Floating-point metrics move with -march=native (FMA contraction), so a
# native build is not comparable with the recorded baselines.
if(ORC_NATIVE_ARCH)
    message(WARNING
        "ORC_NATIVE_ARCH is ON: the videosynth suite's floating-point metrics "
        "are not comparable with baselines.json, which are recorded without "
        "it. Expect differences; do not update the baselines from this build.")
    set(_native_arch_flag --native-arch)
else()
    set(_native_arch_flag "")
endif()

add_test(NAME videosynth_report_reset
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -rf "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR}/results")
set_tests_properties(videosynth_report_reset PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_SETUP videosynth_report
    LABELS "functional;videosynth")
add_test(NAME videosynth_report
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/report.py"
        --output-dir "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        --manifest "${_manifest}"
        --baselines "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_BASELINES}"
        ${_native_arch_flag})
set_tests_properties(videosynth_report PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_CLEANUP videosynth_report
    LABELS "functional;videosynth")

set(_derived "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/orc")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Smoke: cvbs_source reads what the pinned videosynth writes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
orc_videosynth_case(pal_smoke      "${_orc_projects}/smoke/pal_smoke.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_smoke     "${_orc_projects}/smoke/ntsc_smoke.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(pal_m_smoke    "${_orc_projects}/smoke/pal_m_smoke.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(pal_smoke_yc   "${_derived}/smoke-yc/pal_smoke.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_smoke_yc  "${_derived}/smoke-yc/ntsc_smoke.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(pal_m_smoke_yc "${_derived}/smoke-yc/pal_m_smoke.yaml")

orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-smoke
    SOURCES smoke/videosynth_smoke_test.cpp
    STAGES cvbs_source
)
foreach(_smoke IN ITEMS
        "PAL_Composite pal_smoke"
        "PAL_YC pal_smoke_yc"
        "NTSC_Composite ntsc_smoke"
        "NTSC_YC ntsc_smoke_yc"
        "PALM_Composite pal_m_smoke"
        "PALM_YC pal_m_smoke_yc")
    separate_arguments(_smoke)
    list(GET _smoke 0 _test)
    list(GET _smoke 1 _case)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-smoke
        TEST "VideosynthSmoke.${_test}"
        CASES ${_case})
endforeach()

    "${_derived}/smoke-clean/ntsc_smoke_clean.yaml")

    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_conceal
        "${_orc_projects}/conceal/${_system}_conceal.yaml")

        "${_derived}/conceal-clean/${_system}_conceal_clean.yaml")

        "${_derived}/conceal-yc/${_system}_conceal.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_conceal_yc_clean
        "${_derived}/conceal-yc-clean/${_system}_conceal_clean.yaml")

    SOURCES dropout_correct/dropout_correct_truth_test.cpp
    STAGES cvbs_source dropout_correct
)

        "PAL_Composite pal_smoke pal_smoke_clean"
        "PAL_UnmatchedPhaseRegresses pal_smoke pal_smoke_clean"
        "NTSC_Composite ntsc_smoke ntsc_smoke_clean"
        "PALM_Composite pal_m_smoke pal_m_smoke_clean"
        "PAL_Sections pal_dropouts pal_dropouts_clean"
        "NTSC_Sections ntsc_dropouts ntsc_dropouts_clean"
        "PALM_Sections pal_m_dropouts pal_m_dropouts_clean"
        "PAL_Conceal pal_conceal pal_conceal_clean"
        "NTSC_Conceal ntsc_conceal ntsc_conceal_clean"
        "PALM_Conceal pal_m_conceal pal_m_conceal_clean"
        "PAL_ConcealYC pal_conceal_yc pal_conceal_yc_clean"
        "NTSC_ConcealYC ntsc_conceal_yc ntsc_conceal_yc_clean"
        "PALM_ConcealYC pal_m_conceal_yc pal_m_conceal_yc_clean")
    separate_arguments(_truth)
    list(POP_FRONT _truth _test)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-dropout-correct
        TEST "DropoutCorrectTruth.${_test}"
        CASES ${_truth})
endforeach()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Frame Map and Source Align: captures that start late, end early and replay
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
    foreach(_capture IN ITEMS cap1 cap2 cap3 cap4)
        orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_disc_${_capture}
            "${_derived}/alignment-captures/${_system}_disc_${_capture}.yaml")
    endforeach()
endforeach()

# The capture comparison's picture band: two captures of each
# of two pressings whose luma ends at a known frequency.
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
    foreach(_capture IN ITEMS A_cap1 A_cap2 B_cap1 B_cap2)
        orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_band_${_capture}
            "${_derived}/picture-band-captures/${_system}_band_${_capture}.yaml")
    endforeach()
endforeach()

# The band limit: pressing A of the picture-band cases without its
# noise, the truth picture_band_limit is measured against.
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_band_A_clean
        "${_derived}/picture-band-clean/${_system}_band_A_clean.yaml")
endforeach()

orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-picture-band-limit
    SOURCES picture_band_limit/picture_band_limit_truth_test.cpp
    STAGES picture_band_limit
)
foreach(_band IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc" "PALM pal_m")
    separate_arguments(_band)
    list(GET _band 0 _test)
    list(GET _band 1 _system)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-picture-band-limit
        TEST "PictureBandLimitTruth.${_test}"
        CASES ${_system}_band_A_clean ${_system}_band_A_cap1)
endforeach()

# FM Beat Cancel (phase 4): a pressing whose master carries the FM-beat
# herringbone, its noise-free copy (the beat alone on the picture) and the
# truth without the beat.
orc_videosynth_case(pal_fm_beat "${_orc_projects}/fm_beat/pal_fm_beat.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(pal_fm_beat_clean
    "${_derived}/fm-beat-clean/pal_fm_beat_clean.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(pal_fm_beat_truth
    "${_derived}/fm-beat-truth/pal_fm_beat_truth.yaml")

orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-fm-beat-cancel
    SOURCES fm_beat_cancel/fm_beat_cancel_truth_test.cpp
    STAGES fm_beat_cancel
)
# The calibration is core analysis code.
target_include_directories(orc-videosynth-tests-fm-beat-cancel PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/analysis/fm_beat)
foreach(_test IN ITEMS PAL PAL_NoBeat PAL_Calibration)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-fm-beat-cancel
        TEST "FmBeatCancelTruth.${_test}"
        CASES pal_fm_beat pal_fm_beat_clean pal_fm_beat_truth)
endforeach()

# The content check: a disc whose picture changes on every frame,
# and a pressing of it numbered one high from its eleventh frame.
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc)
    foreach(_disc IN ITEMS disc late)
        orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_relabel_${_disc}
            "${_orc_projects}/relabel/${_system}_relabel_${_disc}.yaml")
    endforeach()
endforeach()

# Film with 2:3 pulldown (upstream's projects/general/ntsc_film_*.yaml and
# their film-clv and film-pal-m variants): the Disc Mapper must keep every
# frame of a clean capture in place.
foreach(_film IN ITEMS pulldown mixed)
    orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_film_${_film}
        "${_upstream_projects}/general/ntsc_film_${_film}.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_film_${_film}_clv
        "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/upstream/film-clv/ntsc_film_${_film}_clv.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_film_${_film}_pal_m
        "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/upstream/film-pal-m/ntsc_film_${_film}_pal_m.yaml")
endforeach()

orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-alignment
    SOURCES alignment/source_align_test.cpp alignment/alignment_support.cpp
            alignment/picture_band_test.cpp alignment/content_offset_test.cpp
            alignment/pulldown_test.cpp
    STAGES frame_map source_align
)
# The Disc Mapper and the alignment offsets are core analysis code.
target_include_directories(orc-videosynth-tests-alignment PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/alignment
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/analysis/disc_mapper
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/analysis/source_alignment)
foreach(_alignment IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc" "PALM pal_m")
    separate_arguments(_alignment)
    list(GET _alignment 0 _test)
    list(GET _alignment 1 _system)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-alignment
        TEST "SourceAlignTruth.${_test}"
        CASES ${_system}_disc_cap1 ${_system}_disc_cap2
              ${_system}_disc_cap3 ${_system}_disc_cap4)
endforeach()
foreach(_relabel IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc")
    separate_arguments(_relabel)
    list(GET _relabel 0 _test)
    list(GET _relabel 1 _system)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-alignment
        TEST "ContentOffsetTruth.${_test}"
        CASES ${_system}_relabel_disc ${_system}_relabel_late)
endforeach()
foreach(_film IN ITEMS
        "NTSC_Film ntsc_film_pulldown"
        "NTSC_FilmMixed ntsc_film_mixed"
        "NTSC_FilmClv ntsc_film_pulldown_clv"
        "NTSC_FilmMixedClv ntsc_film_mixed_clv"
        "PALM_Film ntsc_film_pulldown_pal_m"
        "PALM_FilmMixed ntsc_film_mixed_pal_m")
    separate_arguments(_film)
    list(GET _film 0 _test)
    list(GET _film 1 _case)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-alignment
        TEST "PulldownTruth.${_test}"
        CASES ${_case})
endforeach()
foreach(_band IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc" "PALM pal_m")
    separate_arguments(_band)
    list(GET _band 0 _test)
    list(GET _band 1 _system)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-alignment
        TEST "PictureBand.${_test}"
        CASES ${_system}_band_A_cap1 ${_system}_band_A_cap2
              ${_system}_band_B_cap1 ${_system}_band_B_cap2)
endforeach()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stacker: two pressings of four captures, the Domesday model, and two
# captures of one disc
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(_upstream "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/upstream")
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
    set(_pressing_cases ${_system}_pressing_A_cap1_clean)
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_pressing_A_cap1_clean
        "${_upstream}/stacking-clean/${_system}_pressing_A_cap1_clean.yaml")
    foreach(_pressing IN ITEMS A B)
        foreach(_capture IN ITEMS cap1 cap2 cap3 cap4)
            set(_case ${_system}_pressing_${_pressing}_${_capture})
            orc_videosynth_case(${_case}
                "${_upstream}/stacking-captures/${_case}.yaml")
            list(APPEND _pressing_cases ${_case})
        endforeach()
    endforeach()
    set(_pressing_cases_${_system} ${_pressing_cases})
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_capture_A
        "${_orc_projects}/stacking/${_system}_capture_A.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_capture_B
        "${_orc_projects}/stacking/${_system}_capture_B.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_capture_A_clean
        "${_derived}/stacking-clean/${_system}_capture_A_clean.yaml")
    foreach(_capture IN ITEMS recapture chroma_picture chroma_burst)
        orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_capture_A_${_capture}
            "${_derived}/stacking-chroma/${_system}_capture_A_${_capture}.yaml")
    endforeach()
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_held_still
        "${_orc_projects}/stacking/${_system}_held_still.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_held_still_clean
        "${_derived}/stacking-clean/${_system}_held_still_clean.yaml")
    # The Domesday model: four captures of pressing A, two of pressing B.
    set(_domesday_cases ${_system}_domesday_A_clean)
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_domesday_A_clean
        "${_derived}/domesday-clean/${_system}_domesday_A_clean.yaml")
    foreach(_capture IN ITEMS A_cap1 A_cap2 A_cap3 A_cap4 B_cap1 B_cap2)
        set(_case ${_system}_domesday_${_capture})
        orc_videosynth_case(${_case}
            "${_derived}/domesday-captures/${_case}.yaml")
        list(APPEND _domesday_cases ${_case})
    endforeach()
    set(_domesday_cases_${_system} ${_domesday_cases})
    # Pressing A with stamper defects, with pressing B as above.
    if(NOT _system STREQUAL "pal_m")
        set(_defect_cases ${_system}_domesday_A_clean
            ${_system}_domesday_B_cap1 ${_system}_domesday_B_cap2)
        foreach(_capture IN ITEMS cap1 cap2 cap3 cap4)
            set(_case ${_system}_domesday_A_defect_${_capture})
            orc_videosynth_case(${_case}
                "${_derived}/pressing-defect-captures/${_case}.yaml")
            list(APPEND _defect_cases ${_case})
        endforeach()
        set(_defect_cases_${_system} ${_defect_cases})
    endif()
endforeach()

# Film with 2:3 pulldown: four captures of a 40-frame film disc and its
# clean truth (projects/pulldown/).
set(_pulldown_cases ntsc_film_disc_clean)
orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_film_disc_clean
    "${_derived}/pulldown-clean/ntsc_film_disc_clean.yaml")
foreach(_capture IN ITEMS cap1 cap2 cap3 cap4)
    orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_film_disc_${_capture}
        "${_derived}/pulldown-captures/ntsc_film_disc_${_capture}.yaml")
    list(APPEND _pulldown_cases ntsc_film_disc_${_capture})
endforeach()

orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
    SOURCES stacker/stacker_truth_test.cpp alignment/alignment_support.cpp
    STAGES frame_map source_align stacker
)
target_include_directories(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/alignment
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/analysis/disc_mapper
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/analysis/source_alignment)
orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
    TEST "StackerTruth.NTSC_Pulldown"
    CASES ${_pulldown_cases})
foreach(_stacker IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc" "PALM pal_m")
    separate_arguments(_stacker)
    list(GET _stacker 0 _test)
    list(GET _stacker 1 _system)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_Pressings"
        CASES ${_pressing_cases_${_system}})
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_LonePressing"
        CASES ${_pressing_cases_${_system}})
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_DomesdayModel"
        CASES ${_domesday_cases_${_system}})
    set(_pair ${_system}_capture_A ${_system}_capture_B
              ${_system}_capture_A_clean)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_SampleAlign"
        CASES ${_pair})
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_ChromaGainMatch"
        CASES ${_system}_capture_A ${_system}_capture_A_clean
              ${_system}_capture_A_recapture
              ${_system}_capture_A_chroma_picture
              ${_system}_capture_A_chroma_burst)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_HeldStill"
        CASES ${_system}_held_still ${_system}_held_still_clean)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
        TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_EfmSource"
        CASES ${_pair})
    if(NOT _system STREQUAL "pal_m")
        orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-stacker
            TEST "StackerTruth.${_test}_PressingDefect"
            CASES ${_defect_cases_${_system}} ${_domesday_cases_${_system}})
    endif()
endforeach()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chroma decoders, through the video sink
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_patterns
        "${_orc_projects}/decoders/${_system}_patterns.yaml")
    orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_patterns_yc
        "${_derived}/decoders-yc/${_system}_patterns.yaml")
endforeach()
orc_videosynth_case(pal_herringbone
    "${_orc_projects}/decoders/pal_herringbone.yaml")

orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_motion "${_orc_projects}/decoders/ntsc_motion.yaml")
orc_videosynth_case(ntsc_motion_yc "${_derived}/decoders-yc/ntsc_motion.yaml")

find_program(FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE ffmpeg)
set(_media "${ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_PROJECTS_DIR}/media")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_media}")

# The sink cases play sink_audio.wav: seeded noise at 44.1 kHz 16-bit, the
# EFM rate, made beside copies of the projects so the EFM decode can be
# compared with it sample for sample.
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
    configure_file("${_orc_projects}/sinks/${_system}_sinks.yaml"
        "${_media}/${_system}_sinks.yaml" COPYONLY)
endforeach()
# The weave cases' media, beside copies of the projects
# (projects/sinks/*_weave.yaml).
foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc)
    configure_file("${_orc_projects}/sinks/${_system}_weave.yaml"
        "${_media}/${_system}_weave.yaml" COPYONLY)
endforeach()
if(FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${_media}/sink_audio.wav"
        COMMAND ${FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE} -hide_banner -loglevel error -y
            -f lavfi
            -i "anoisesrc=seed=4242:sample_rate=44100:amplitude=0.3:color=white"
            -t 2.5 -ac 2 -c:a pcm_s16le "${_media}/sink_audio.wav"
        COMMENT "Making the sink cases' audio"
        VERBATIM)
    # Each weave case's still (smooth sinusoids, a camera's vertical detail)
    # and its interlaced motion (luma bars moving 3 samples a field, made at
    # the field rate and paired into frames in the standard's field order).
    set(_weave_media)
    foreach(_weave IN ITEMS
            "pal 720x576 25 50 interleave_top tff tt"
            "ntsc 720x486 30000/1001 60000/1001 interleave_bottom bff bb")
        separate_arguments(_weave)
        list(GET _weave 0 _system)
        list(GET _weave 1 _size)
        list(GET _weave 2 _frame_rate)
        list(GET _weave 3 _field_rate)
        list(GET _weave 4 _pairing)
        list(GET _weave 5 _setfield)
        list(GET _weave 6 _field_order)
        set(_still "${_media}/${_system}_weave_still.mkv")
        set(_clip "${_media}/${_system}_weave_interlaced.mkv")
        add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT "${_still}"
            COMMAND ${FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE} -hide_banner -loglevel error -y
                -f lavfi
                -i "nullsrc=s=${_size}:r=${_frame_rate},format=yuv444p,geq=lum='128+50*sin((X+Y)/7)+40*sin(Y/6)+20*sin(X/3)':cb=128:cr=128"
                -frames:v 6 -c:v ffv1 -pix_fmt yuv422p10le "${_still}"
            COMMENT "Making the ${_system} weave case's still"
            VERBATIM)
        add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT "${_clip}"
            COMMAND ${FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE} -hide_banner -loglevel error -y
                -f lavfi
                -i "nullsrc=s=${_size}:r=${_field_rate},format=yuv444p,geq=lum='128+90*sin((X+3*N)/9)':cb=128:cr=128,tinterlace=mode=${_pairing},setfield=${_setfield}"
                -frames:v 6 -c:v ffv1 -pix_fmt yuv422p10le
                -field_order ${_field_order} "${_clip}"
            COMMENT "Making the ${_system} weave case's interlaced motion"
            VERBATIM)
        list(APPEND _weave_media "${_still}" "${_clip}")
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(videosynth-sink-media ALL
        DEPENDS "${_media}/sink_audio.wav" ${_weave_media})
    foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc pal_m)
        orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_sinks
            "${_media}/${_system}_sinks.yaml")
    endforeach()
    foreach(_system IN ITEMS pal ntsc)
        orc_videosynth_case(${_system}_weave
            "${_media}/${_system}_weave.yaml")
    endforeach()
endif()

# The video sink and its decoders live in sinks/common, outside the STAGES
# naming, so they are linked here.
if(TARGET orc-stage-plugin-video-sink)
    orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-decoders
        SOURCES decoders/chroma_decoder_test.cpp
    )
    target_include_directories(orc-videosynth-tests-decoders PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/include
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/plugins/stages/sinks/common)
    target_link_libraries(orc-videosynth-tests-decoders
        orc-stage-plugin-video-sink)
    foreach(_decoder IN ITEMS
            "PAL pal pal2d" "PAL pal transform2d" "PAL pal transform3d"
            "NTSC ntsc ntsc1d" "NTSC ntsc ntsc2d" "NTSC ntsc ntsc3d"
            "NTSC ntsc ntsc3dnoadapt"
            "PALM pal_m pal2d" "PALM pal_m transform2d"
            "PALM pal_m transform3d")
        separate_arguments(_decoder)
        list(GET _decoder 0 _test)
        list(GET _decoder 1 _system)
        list(GET _decoder 2 _name)
        orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-decoders
            TEST "DecoderTruth.${_test}_${_name}"
            CASES ${_system}_patterns ${_system}_patterns_yc)
    endforeach()
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-decoders
        TEST "DecoderTruth.NTSC_ntsc3d_FieldPhase"
        CASES ntsc_motion ntsc_motion_yc)
    orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-decoders
        TEST "DecoderTruth.PAL_Herringbone"
        CASES pal_herringbone pal_patterns)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sinks: audio, EFM, the CVBS round trip and the video sink
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_program(FFPROBE_EXECUTABLE ffprobe)
if(TARGET orc-stage-plugin-video-sink AND FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE
   AND FFPROBE_EXECUTABLE)
    orc_add_videosynth_test_executable(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks
        SOURCES sinks/sinks_test.cpp
        STAGES audio_sink cvbs_sink efm_sink stacker
    )
    target_include_directories(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/core/include
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/orc/plugins/stages/sinks/common)
    target_link_libraries(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks
        orc-stage-plugin-video-sink)
    target_compile_definitions(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks PRIVATE
        ORC_FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE="${FFMPEG_EXECUTABLE}"
        ORC_FFPROBE_EXECUTABLE="${FFPROBE_EXECUTABLE}"
        ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_MEDIA_DIR="${_media}")
    add_dependencies(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks videosynth-sink-media)
    foreach(_sink IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc" "PALM pal_m")
        separate_arguments(_sink)
        list(GET _sink 0 _test)
        list(GET _sink 1 _system)
        foreach(_kind IN ITEMS Audio CvbsRoundTrip Efm)
            orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks
                TEST "SinkTruth.${_test}_${_kind}"
                CASES ${_system}_sinks)
        endforeach()
        orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks
            TEST "SinkTruth.${_test}_VideoFrames"
            CASES ${_system}_patterns)
        orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks
            TEST "SinkTruth.${_test}_HeldSchedule"
            CASES ${_system}_held_still)
    endforeach()
    foreach(_sink IN ITEMS "PAL pal" "NTSC ntsc")
        separate_arguments(_sink)
        list(GET _sink 0 _test)
        list(GET _sink 1 _system)
        orc_videosynth_tests(orc-videosynth-tests-sinks
            TEST "SinkTruth.${_test}_Weave"
            CASES ${_system}_weave)
    endforeach()
else()
    message(WARNING "The videosynth suite's sink cases need the video sink, "
                    "ffmpeg and ffprobe; they are not registered.")
endif()

# The list of tests and their cases, for the run report to name every test,
# including those that did not run.
get_property(_manifest_lines GLOBAL PROPERTY ORC_VIDEOSYNTH_TEST_MANIFEST)
list(JOIN _manifest_lines "\n" _manifest_text)
file(WRITE "${_manifest}" "${_manifest_text}\n")
